name: line-mcp-server
stderr:
Usage: line-mcp <command>

  login      Log in by QR code as a secondary Android device
  status     Show the bound account, session and sync state
  probe      Read-only live checks [--dm <mid>] [--group <mid>] [--square <mid>]
  daemon     Run the sync daemon (started by the background service)
  install    Install and start the background service [--dry-run] [--node <path>]
  uninstall  Stop and remove the background service; keeps the archive [--dry-run] [--purge]
  doctor     Check the local setup without contacting LINE

Tool commands call the running daemon; line-mcp <command> --help lists the flags:

  sync-status        Session health, last sync times, unreconciled coverage gaps, backfill progress, archive size and time_zone, the zone whose offset every time carries
  query              Read-only SQL over the local SQLite archive of the user's LINE account
  get-attachment     Attachment of an image, video, audio or file message: metadata, or with download true the file saved to a private cache and its local path
  get-announcements  Pinned announcements of a group, room or OpenChat chat, asked from LINE
  get-profile        Profile from LINE: without id the connected LINE account; a Talk user MID; or with service square an OpenChat member ID (starting with p)
  send-message       Sends a message from the connected LINE account: text, or a local image (JPEG, PNG, GIF) or file, optionally as a reply
  react              Reacts to a message as the connected LINE account
  unsend             Unsends a message the connected LINE account sent, for everyone
(node:1) ExperimentalWarning: SQLite is an experimental feature and might change at any time
(Use `node --trace-warnings ...` to show where the warning was created)
